messages:
Nora (partnerships): Quick gate-check before tomorrow's marketplace publish. Need confirmation on embargo time, partner imagery, SI test accounts, and partner analytics access.
Evan (eng): API and listing UI smoke passed. Two small items: badge sprite path differs between mobile & desktop, and CDN purge scheduled at T-5m.
Maya (PR): Embargo set for 11:00 PT. Press kit ready. Still missing high-res EdgeWorks hero shot by EOD or we'll use alt image.
Liam (growth): Landing page variant C ready. Will switch to C at +15m if traffic looks healthy. UTMs are in place.
Rohit (si - CoreIntegrate): SI test accounts request received; need SSO creds by 07:30 PT to run end-to-end tests. Also sending a tiny schema note about manifest fields.
Tara (legal): Trademark checks cleared. EdgeWorks requested exact brand string: "EdgeWorks®" in partner blurbs. No edits allowed.
cdn-bot: scheduled purge: /assets/partners -> 10:55 PT.
Evan (eng): I've fixed the sprite path; will flip the mobile asset pointer at 10:45 PT. Also will provision SI test tokens at 07:20 PT.
Nora (partnerships): EdgeWorks confirms hero shot delivery by 17:40 PT and accepted analytics invite. Thanks Rohit for the test tokens.
Maya (PR): Sending embargo reminder at 10:00 PT to press list. If imagery changes after that, I'll issue an update in the press thread.
Rohit (si - CoreIntegrate): Integration smoke from test token passed at 07:35 PT. Minor 202 on first embedding call; adapter retries handled it.
Liam (growth): Prewarm cache for partner assets at 10:50 PT. We'll monitor CTR and bounce in first 30m.
Evan (eng): CDN purge executed at 10:55 PT; landing TTL set to 45s for first 10 minutes.
cdn-bot: purge complete at 10:55 PT.
Maya (PR): Embargo lifted at 11:00 PT. First pickups incoming, I've logged them in PR tracker.
Nora (partnerships): Partner follow-up tasks: post launch analytics link, schedule partner spotlight with EdgeWorks next Tue, and confirm SI onboarding docs. I'll send summary now.
Tara (legal): EdgeWorks brand string verified in live copy. All good.
Nora (partnerships): Closing thread 1: thanks everyone. :tada:
